verdict.rationale: ADP's RUN pages say only that experts can help set up "payroll, benefits, and more" and that payroll can be connected with benefits tools to reduce duplicate work. That glancingly suggests benefits linked to payroll, but nothing specifically shows health insurance being offered or administered inside RUN. Missing for 10: documented health plan offering/administration, employee enrollment workflows, automatic premium deduction sync to payroll, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
